raw_comparison: Fourteen recognizable male priest portraits remain, with clearer black shirts and white tabs than paired-loss variants. Some contrast/framing/detail changes, but no decisive photographic-quality improvement. The same two bottom-right catastrophic architectural face failures persist. Fixed grid remains dominated by similar dark wavy hair and faces; no unseen diversity conclusion.
ema_psi07_comparison: Mouth and eye legibility improve somewhat in several tiles relative to500, but lower-face texture remains patchy, smeared or visibly synthetic. All16 contain recognizable faces and white tabs; no raw-style whole-face architectural replacement in this truncated grid. Similar faces and hair dominate. No photographic-quality pass.
ema_psi1_comparison: Some previously ghosted facial detail becomes more legible, but severe lower-face distortions persist. r2c2 has conflicting pale torso/black collar structure; r3c2 retains microphone/ambiguous mixed clothing. r4c3 has malformed face and extra-person/background content. r4c4 now shows prominent architectural stripes over right face, worse than500. Color traces persist, particularly r1c3 clothing; raw saved grid is near monochrome.
eligibility: Visible adult male presentation and collars in recognizable raw samples do not offset two failed faces. No obvious hats in this fixed16, but it does not establish no-hat eligibility or attractiveness over unseen latents.
limits: Only fixed16 per variant. No numerical weight validation, memorization assessment or new-seed evaluation performed by this reviewer. completed.json finite_update_checks=false is not a numeric pass; root owns separate numeric validation.
